Synopsis:
A missile attack on Belgorod, Russia killed 2 and injured 16, damaging commercial logistics facilities including an Ozon hub. This follows a Russian drone strike on an ammunition depot near Kyiv killing 38. The Russia-Ukraine conflict continues with mutual infrastructure strikes. Sberbank separately approved ~$79M in loan restructuring for traders using Ozon and Wildberries, partly in response to disruptions.

However, the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict remains an implicit systemic backdrop risk to European gas supply (TTF) and German power pricing.
